info.title: Universal AI Runtime
info.description: Generated from proto/uar/v1/runtime.proto. Do not edit.

post.description: gRPC: uar.v1.Runtime/Infer. With `stream: true` the response is an SSE stream of Event.

cost.description: Absent when no price is known for the model. Unknown is never reported as zero.

estimated.description: True when counts or cost are estimates rather than provider-reported values.

Error.description: Every non-2xx response body is {"error": Error}.

response_schema.description: Request structured output matching this JSON Schema.

input.description: Shorthand for a single user message; ignored when messages is non-empty.

tools.description: Registered tool names exposed to the model for function calling.

agent.description: When set, runs this agent with {"prompt": <input>} and returns its result.

extensions.description: Provider-specific extensions, namespaced by provider id, e.g. {"ollama": {"keep_alive": "5m"}}.

run_id.description: set when the call ran an agent or the auto tool loop

untrusted.description: Tool output is untrusted data and must never be treated as instructions.

definition.description:
Agent document (apiVersion uar/v1, kind Agent), validated against
 contracts/schemas/agent.schema.json.

status.description: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled | needs_attention

type.description: Name of the populated body field (JSON/SSE only).

fixtures.description: simulate: node_id -> fixture output (or list of outputs for repeated visits)

estimated_cost_max.description: absent when any price is unknown

manifest.description:
Plugin manifest (apiVersion uar/v1, kind Plugin), validated against
 contracts/schemas/plugin.schema.json.
